text:
Maya Lin: Heads-up: we need a pared-down offer ready to submit to AWS/GCP/Azure staging tomorrow. Target: single trial SKU + standard paid SKU. Short window.
Leo Park: I can prep the container/image artifacts tonight. Which trial SKU id do we standardize on?
Maya Lin: Use rw-inference-trial-14d. Keep price=0 and include 14-day trial entitlement.
Sana Iqbal: I'll start the legal checklist and privacy blurb. Quick ask: do we allow telemetry by default or opt-in?
Maya Lin: Default minimal telemetry (latency, model_version, token_counts) with opt-in for content logging. Mark that in the listing.
build-bot: Build pipeline triggered for tag=release/marketplace-2419, expected artifacts: docker (gcr/registry), aws-ami (us-east-1), azure-vhd.
Leo Park: Build finished for docker & AMI. AMI IDs: ami-0abc123def4567890 (us-east-1). Uploaded GCR image: gcr.io/redwood/rw-inference:marketplace-2419. Azure VHD upload in progress.
Ops-Integrator: Note: Azure publisher reqs need a CSV SKU mapping and an offer manifest. Sample: rw-inference-trial-14d,TRIAL,14,credit.
Sana Iqbal: Draft EULA ready; adding a short addendum for EU data residency. Will stub out vendor addenda.
Maya Lin: Thanks. Action items: Leo finalize Azure VHD by midnight, Sana finalize EULA + privacy blurb, I'll assemble the offer YAML and submit to staging. Sync 9am PT tomorrow for final verification.
Leo Park: Will post the Azure VHD link when done.
Sana Iqbal: Privacy blurb snippet: "We collect anonymized inference metrics and operational logs for billing and reliability. Customer content is not retained unless explicitly enabled by the customer."
Maya Lin: Perfect. Closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
